thisPolicyExplainsWhat: This policy explains what information Pinzos collects, how we use it, and the rights you have.
pinzosPinzosComWe: Pinzos (pinzos.com, "we") is an interactive platform for exploring Dubai property. This policy covers all services on pinzos.com and its subdomains.
accountInformationWhenYou: Account information: when you sign in with Google or an email code, we receive your name, email address and profile picture. We never see or store your Google password.
contactDetailsYouChoose: Contact details you choose to share: if you ask to be contacted by an agent (e.g. leaving a phone or WeChat number), we record it so the follow-up can happen.
usageDataPagesAnd: Usage data: pages and projects viewed, searches, favorites, approximate location (inferred from IP), device and browser type. Used to improve the product and help the agent serving you understand your preferences.
lunaVoiceAndText: Luna voice and text conversations: audio is processed in real time by Google Gemini; transcripts and query records are stored to improve the service and enable agent follow-up.
paymentInformationAgentSubscriptions: Payment information (agent subscriptions only): handled by Stripe; we never store your card number.
toProvideAndImprove: To provide and improve the platform (map, analytics, AI assistant).
toConnectYouWith: To connect you with a real-estate agent when you request it.
securityAbusePreventionAnd: Security, abuse prevention and quota enforcement.
weDoNotSell: We do not sell your personal information. We share it only:
withTheRealEstate: With the real-estate agent serving you: if you leave contact details or join a tour they host, your contact info and related browsing preferences are shared with that agent for follow-up.
withTheServiceProviders: With the service providers listed below, only as needed to run the service.
whenRequiredByLaw: When required by law (e.g. a court order).
thePlatformReliesOn: The platform relies on these providers, each processing data under its own privacy policy:
googleSignInGemini: Google Sign-In; Gemini AI (the Luna voice/text assistant)
weUseCookiesAnd: We use cookies and browser local storage to keep you signed in, remember preferences like language, and maintain an anonymous visitor identifier for usage analytics and quotas. We do not do cross-site advertising tracking.
weKeepTheData: We keep the data above while your account is active. You can email {{CONTACT_EMAIL}} at any time to request deletion of your account and personal data; we will complete it within 30 days, except records we must keep for legal or accounting reasons.
allDataIsEncrypted: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and access is permission-controlled. Servers are located in the EU (Germany); some providers operate in the US and Canada. By using the platform you consent to such cross-border processing.
thePlatformIsIntended: The platform is intended for property buyers and professionals, not for anyone under 18.
updatesWillBePosted: Updates will be posted on this page; material changes will be announced in the app.
byUsingPinzosYou: By using Pinzos you agree to these terms.
theseTermsGovernYour: These terms govern your use of Pinzos (pinzos.com, "we"). By accessing or using the platform you agree to them; if you do not agree, please stop using it.
pinzosProvidesAnInteractive: Pinzos provides an interactive map and analytics for Dubai property, drawing on Dubai Land Department (DLD) public records, developer materials and third-party sources, plus AI assistants, guided tours and tools for agents.
pricesTransactionsRentsReturns: Prices, transactions, rents, returns and other data are provided “as is” and may be delayed, incomplete or contain errors.
nothingOnThePlatform: Nothing on the platform (including AI-generated answers and analysis) constitutes investment, legal, tax or financial advice.
verifyInformationIndependentlyAnd: Verify information independently and consult licensed professionals before any purchase decision. AI answers can be inaccurate.
youMustProvideAccurate: You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure. We may suspend or terminate accounts involved in abuse, fraud or violations of these terms.
scrapeBulkExportOr: Scrape, bulk-export or resell platform data (including map area boundaries, transaction/rental data and AI outputs).
reverseEngineerOrDisrupt: Reverse-engineer or disrupt the service, or circumvent usage limits and billing.
useThePlatformFor: Use the platform for unlawful purposes, or present AI output as official or professional advice.
agentSubscriptionsAreProcessed: Agent subscriptions are processed by Stripe and renew automatically monthly or yearly; you can cancel anytime, effective at the end of the current billing period.
cancellingWithinAFree: Cancelling within a free trial incurs no charge. Price changes will be notified in advance and never apply retroactively.
thePlatformSoftwareDesign: The platform software, design, report templates and curated data (including hand-drawn area boundaries) belong to us or our licensors; you receive a non-transferable personal licence to use them. Developer brochures and their assets belong to their owners.
agentAndDeveloperUsers: Agent and developer users must have the legal right to any material they upload (brochures, images, quotes); we may remove content suspected of infringement.
toTheMaximumExtent: To the maximum extent permitted by law: the platform is provided “as is” without warranties of any kind; we are not liable for indirect damages, lost profits or lost data; our total liability is capped at the fees you paid us in the past 12 months (USD 100 for free users).
theseTermsAreGoverned: These terms are governed by the laws of British Columbia, Canada, and disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of its courts.
